comment: The mix is a plain weighted sum, input 1 times (6 minus the output index) over 6 plus input 2 times the output index over 6 (src/Medusa.cpp:33), and nothing clamps it, so two 10V inputs give 10V out and larger inputs pass straight through. The ports are given the cv family because the panel itself prints CV IN on both inputs; the module would pass audio just as happily.
